app.name: Alpine OTA Updater
intro.title: Update your MeshCore node over the air
intro.lead: Pick the device and firmware, download it once, then send it to the node over Bluetooth or WiFi. Downloaded files stay on this device for later.
step.label: Step {n}:
board.hint: Choose the hardware of the node you want to update.
board.search: Search devices, e.g. RAK, T114, Heltec V3

connect.noBluetooth: This browser has no Bluetooth support. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer or an Android device.
connect.ble.title: Put the node into update mode
connect.ble.step.1: In your companion app, log in to the node as admin.
connect.ble.step.2: Send the command start ota. The node restarts its Bluetooth and appears as {name}.
connect.ble.step.3: Keep this device within a few metres of the node, then press Scan.
connect.wifi.title: Connect to the node's WiFi
connect.wifi.step.1: In your companion app, log in to the node as admin and send start ota. It replies with “Started: {url}”.
connect.wifi.step.2: Open the WiFi settings of this device and join the open network {ssid}.
connect.wifi.step.3: If the device warns that the network has no internet, choose to stay connected.
connect.wifi.step.4: Come back to this app without closing it, then press Scan.
connect.wifi.offlineNote: The node's WiFi has no internet. Download the firmware before you switch networks; this app keeps working offline.
connect.comingSoon: Scanning and updating arrive in the next version.
flash.comingSoon: The update step will be available in the next version.
